player_prompt.intro:
Ni Mwana {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Pa boli, mafuta yawe yakatontonka '{player_stone}' na mafuta ya mwana wako yakatontonka '{opponent_stone}'.

Pa mwaka yawe, chachine mo celli iliyo leza (kwa chaka chake) na pangeni mafuta yawe kuli.
Ici ni mfano, '[12]' pangisha mafuta yawe mu celli 12.

Chifweno chiyambe ni kukola luso la mafuta yawe lya kuikata pamo na pamo za boli (ku bika kufika ku mwela au ku bika kufika ku kuba).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Inambala ya nselo iyabula ukufikapo {cell_num}. Ifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na {max_board_num} .
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Iselo {cell_num} lili kale na bambi. Saleni isele ili fye libili.

action.placement: Mwana {current_player_id} wapanga symbol yawe ({symbol}) mu celli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Player {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') alikwatiisha mbali zibili za bode!
